name: LocalDock
description: Work-in-progress: pull WordPress sites from cPanel servers over SSH, run them locally with DDEV, and sync changes back like Source Control.

cover.alt: LocalDock for Orca, beside its sidebar showing local and server changes for an example WordPress site.

screenshots.alt: The LocalDock sidebar listing local changes, server changes and files changed on both sides, grouped by theme and plugin.
screenshots.caption: Sync like Source Control

screenshots.alt: The list of WordPress sites found on a cPanel server, and the offer to resume a pull that stopped part-way.
screenshots.caption: Pick a site, pull it, resume if it stops

screenshots.alt: The database section with table groups to push, and a notice that the live database was backed up first.
screenshots.caption: Push the database, with a backup
